## Source: kam193 (ba0285d49d46cd93cdcad1582bb1c013beb3791dc901a0a3c96f3801dba9d909)
This package is prepared to be used as a malicious loader. It pins pydash dependency in a vulnerable version allowing reaching out of the object scope when calling `pydash.invoke(...)`. The code to reach it is intended to be delivered from the now-benign GitHub file, which is then splited and passed to the vulnerable function. The same Github user account is also involved in publishing a repository that executes embedded encrypted code when called with specific arguments. The package was originally flagged by PyPI Security.


---

Category: MALICIOUS - The campaign has clearly malicious intent, like infostealers.


Campaign: 2026-11-dashloom


Reasons (based on the campaign):


 - action-hidden-in-lib-usage


 - Downloads and executes a remote malicious script.
